"""Cold load and ordinary-input exploration; snapshots remain read-only."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse,hashlib,json,math,sys,time
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from probe_base import ObservedRuntime,ROOT,HERE
from s760_runtime import RuntimeConfig

ap=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
ap.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True)
a=ap.parse_args();work=a.output.resolve();work.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
source=ROOT/'docs/ic20-hle-findings/chatGPT-work/bluescsi-feasibility-2026-10-18/stereo-04/captured-stereo.img'
cfg=RuntimeConfig(ROOT/'mame-source/mames760.exe',ROOT/'roms/BOOT/Roland_S-760_v1.11.BIN',ROOT/'roms/System/S760224.IMG',work/'runtime',source,sound=False,throttle=False,wave_dump=work/'wave.bin')
inputs=[source,cfg.executable,cfg.boot_rom,cfg.system_disk,Path(__file__),HERE/'observer.lua',HERE/'probe_base.py']
hashes={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in inputs}
actions=[]
with ObservedRuntime(cfg) as rt:
 def wait(seconds):
  end=rt.request('status')[0]['seconds']+seconds;deadline=time.monotonic()+90
  while rt.request('status')[0]['seconds']<end:
   assert time.monotonic()<deadline,'Native clock stopped'
   time.sleep(.01)
 def button(port,name):
  rt.request('button',port=port,name=name,down=True);wait(.12)
  rt.request('button',port=port,name=name,down=False);wait(.25)
 def click(x,y):
  rt.request('pointer',x=x,y=y);wait(.25);button(':NATIVE_MOUSE_BUTTONS','Mouse Left')
 def shot(name):
  assert name.replace('-','').replace('_','').isalnum()
  frames=rt.request('frames')
  Image.frombytes('RGBA',(640,480),frames[1][0][6:]).save(work/(name+'.png'))
  item=dict(name=name,snapshot=rt.snapshot_count,seconds=rt.request('status')[0]['seconds'])
  actions.append(item);print(json.dumps(item),flush=True)
 def render(frames):
  out=[]
  while frames:
   n=min(frames,8192);out.append(rt.render_audio(n)[1]);frames-=n
  return b''.join(out)
 wait(20);button(':NATIVE_MEDIA','Insert Sample Floppy')
 click(118,5);click(80,22);wait(8);click(20,22);wait(1);click(25,54);wait(2)
 click(10,98);click(76,98);wait(35);shot('cold-loaded')
 click(100,5);wait(1);click(80,26);wait(3);shot('loop-screen')
 rt.request('pause')
 print('READY',flush=True)
 request_id=0;deadline=time.monotonic()+900
 while time.monotonic()<deadline:
  path=work/f'command-{request_id:03}.json'
  if not path.exists():time.sleep(.05);continue
  commands=json.loads(path.read_text())
  quit_requested=False
  for command in commands:
   op=command['op'];actions.append(dict(command=command))
   if op=='quit':quit_requested=True;break
   if op=='audio':
    name=command['name'];rt.request('pause');rt.request('audio_capture',enabled=True)
    rt.request('midi',bytes=[0x90,command.get('note',60),100]);pcm=render(65536)
    rt.request('midi',bytes=[0x80,command.get('note',60),0]);tail=render(88200)
    rt.request('audio_capture',enabled=False)
    (work/(name+'.pcm')).write_bytes(pcm);(work/(name+'-tail.pcm')).write_bytes(tail)
    v=np.frombuffer(pcm,dtype='<f4').reshape(-1,2)
    row=dict(audio=name,peaks=np.max(np.abs(v),axis=0).tolist(),rms=np.sqrt(np.mean(v*v,axis=0)).tolist(),sha256=hashlib.sha256(pcm).hexdigest())
    actions.append(row);print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
   else:
    rt.request('resume')
    if op=='click':click(command['x'],command['y'])
    elif op=='wait':wait(command['seconds'])
    elif op=='button':button(command.get('port',':PANEL2'),command['name'])
    elif op=='dial':rt.request('pointer',x=command['x'],y=command['y']);wait(.3);rt.request('dial',id='ALPHA',delta=command['delta']);wait(1)
    elif op=='shot':shot(command['name'])
    else:raise ValueError(op)
    rt.request('pause')
  (work/f'done-{request_id:03}.json').write_text(json.dumps(actions[-len(commands):]))
  request_id+=1
  if quit_requested:break
 else:raise TimeoutError('Exploration command deadline')
assert all(hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==hashes[str(p.relative_to(ROOT))] for p in inputs)
(work/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(actions=actions,identities=hashes,source_unchanged=True),indent=2)+'\n')

"""Run existing native acceptance workflows with read-only BS1 observations."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'scripts'))
import s760_runtime

class ObservedRuntime(s760_runtime.NativeRuntime):
    def _start(self,timeout):
        folder=self.config.state_dir.resolve()/'bs1-observer'
        folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
        wrapper=folder/'wrapper.lua'
        observer=folder/'observer.lua'
        shutil.copyfile(HERE/'observer.lua',observer)
        wrapper.write_text('dofile('+json.dumps((ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.lua').as_posix())+')\n'
                           +'dofile('+json.dumps(observer.as_posix())+')\n',encoding='utf-8')
        launch=subprocess.Popen
        def observed(command,**kwargs):
            command=list(command)
            command[command.index('-autoboot_script')+1]=str(wrapper)
            kwargs['env']['BS1_OBSERVER_DIR']=folder.as_posix()
            return launch([*command,'-log'],**kwargs)
        self.observation_folder=folder
        self.snapshot_count=0
        with patch('s760_runtime.subprocess.Popen',side_effect=observed):
            super()._start(timeout)

    def request(self,operation,**kwargs):
        result=super().request(operation,**kwargs)
        if operation=='frames':
            self.snapshot_count+=1
            tag=f'frame-{self.snapshot_count:02}'
            temporary=self.observation_folder/'snapshot-request.tmp'
            temporary.write_text(tag,encoding='ascii')
            temporary.replace(self.observation_folder/'snapshot-request.txt')
            deadline=time.monotonic()+10
            while not (self.observation_folder/(tag+'.json')).exists():
                if self.process.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError('Observer process stopped')
                if time.monotonic()>deadline:raise TimeoutError('Read-only snapshot timed out')
                time.sleep(.02)
        return result

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--workflow',choices=('stereo','scsi-save'),required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    workflow=ROOT/'scripts'/('verify_native_sampling_input.py' if args.workflow=='stereo' else 'verify_native_scsi_save.py')
    files=[Path(__file__),HERE/'observer.lua',workflow,ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.py',ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.lua',ROOT/'mame-source/mames760.exe',ROOT/'S760224.IMG',ROOT/'roms/BOOT/Roland_S-760_v1.11.BIN']
    identity={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in files}
    sys.argv=[str(workflow),'--state-dir',str(args.output.resolve())]
    if args.workflow=='stereo':
        sys.argv+=['--blank-disk',str(ROOT/'docs/ic20-hle-findings/chatGPT-work/media-verification-20261012-065549/formatted.img')]
    with patch.object(s760_runtime,'NativeRuntime',ObservedRuntime):
        runpy.run_path(str(workflow),run_name='__main__')
    assert all(hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==identity[str(p.relative_to(ROOT))] for p in files), 'Input changed during observation'
    (args.output/'observer-identities.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2)+'\n')

if __name__=='__main__':main()

-- Read-only observations of original firmware. No guest writes or forced events.
local json=require('json')
local machine=manager.machine
local cpu=machine.devices[':maincpu']
local p,r=cpu.spaces['program'],cpu.spaces['register']
local ram,banks
for name,index in pairs(machine.devices[':'].items) do
 if name:match('/m_banked_ram$') then ram=emu.item(index) end
 if name:match('/m_bank_regs$') then banks=emu.item(index) end
end
assert(ram and ram.count==0x100000 and banks)
local folder=assert(os.getenv('BS1_OBSERVER_DIR'))
local log=assert(io.open(folder..'/observations.jsonl','w'))
local inspecting=false
local function word(a) return banks:read(a-0x100)|(banks:read(a-0xff)<<8) end
local function physical(a,fetch) return (word((fetch and 0x100 or 0x108)+2*(a>>14))<<10)+(a&0x3fff) end
local function raw(a,n)
 local out={}
 for i=0,n-1 do
  local x=physical((a+i)&0xffff,false)
  if x>=ram.count then return nil end
  out[#out+1]=string.format('%02x',ram:read(x))
 end
 return table.concat(out)
end
local function context(kind)
 local row={kind=kind,seconds=machine.time:as_double(),pc=cpu.state['CURPC'].value,psw=cpu.state['PSW'].value,selectors={},registers={}}
 for a=0x100,0x10e,2 do row.selectors[string.format('%04x',a)]=word(a) end
 for _,a in ipairs({0x18,0x1c,0x1e,0x28,0x2a,0x2c,0x2e,0x42,0x48,0x4a,0x4c,0x4e,0x58,0xb8,0xba,0xbc,0xbe,0xda}) do row.registers[string.format('%02x',a)]=r:read_u16(a) end
 row.physical_pc=physical(row.pc,true)
 row.stack=raw(r:read_u16(0x18),16)
 row.target_state=raw(0x3620,0x30)
 row.descriptor=raw(r:read_u16(0x48),16)
 return row
end
local function emit(row) log:write(json.stringify(row)..'\n');log:flush() end
local call_count=0
local returns={}
local examples={}
local taps={}
-- Tap handles remove themselves at Lua garbage collection; retain the handles.
_G.bs1_observer_taps=taps
taps[#taps+1]=p:install_write_tap(0x102,0x103,'bs1-call',function(a,d,m)
 if inspecting then return end
 local before=word(0x102)
 local sp=r:read_u16(0x18)
 local target=r:read_u16(0x1e)
 local entry=d==0x3b and target>=0x73d6 and target<0x8000 and cpu.state['CURPC'].value==0xce22
 local returning=before==0x3b and cpu.state['CURPC'].value==0xce36 and returns[sp]
 if entry or returning then
  -- POP increments SP before the selector write tap fires: all 12 saved
  -- bytes are already popped when CE36 is observed.
  if entry then returns[sp+12]=target else target=returns[sp];returns[sp]=nil end
  call_count=call_count+1
  inspecting=true
  local row=context('selector-write');row.before=before;row.value=d;row.routine=target;row.direction=entry and 'entry' or 'return'
  if entry and target==0x7592 then
   local ptr=r:read_u16(0x48)
   if ptr>=0x4000 and ptr<0x8000 then
    row.sender_descriptor_fixed_page=ram:read_block((0x2cc<<10)+(ptr&0x3fff),16):gsub('.',function(c) return string.format('%02x',string.byte(c)) end)
   end
  end
  local key=string.format('%04x-%s-%s',target,row.direction,(row.sender_descriptor_fixed_page or ''):sub(1,4))
  examples[key]=(examples[key] or 0)+1
  if examples[key]<=12 then emit(row) end
  inspecting=false
 end
end)
local commands=0
taps[#taps+1]=p:install_write_tap(0xe404,0xe405,'bs1-spc-control',function(a,d,m)
 if inspecting or physical(a,false)~=0x102404 then return end
 commands=commands+1
 if commands<=2000 then
  inspecting=true local row=context('spc-control');row.value=d;row.mask=m;emit(row);inspecting=false
 end
end)
local ranges={{0x03d3e,0x05c80},{0xdabe4,0xe435c},{0xe435e,0xe7c00},{0xe8010,0xec000},{0xec000,0xed338},{0xed3f8,0xf0000},{0xf53d4,0xfc000},{0xfc000,0x100000}}
local writes={}
for i=1,#ranges do writes[i]={count=0,first={}} end
taps[#taps+1]=p:install_write_tap(0x120,0xffff,'bs1-candidate-writes',function(a,d,m)
 if inspecting then return end
 local x=physical(a,false)
 for i,range in ipairs(ranges) do
  if x>=range[1] and x<range[2] then
   local w=writes[i];w.count=w.count+1
   if #w.first<8 then w.first[#w.first+1]={address=a,physical=x,data=d,mask=m,pc=cpu.state['CURPC'].value,fetch_page=word(0x100+2*(cpu.state['CURPC'].value>>14)),seconds=machine.time:as_double()} end
   break
  end
 end
end)
local seen=''
emu.register_periodic(function()
 local f=io.open(folder..'/snapshot-request.txt','r')
 if not f then return end
 local tag=f:read('*a');f:close()
 if tag==seen or not tag:match('^[%w_-]+$') then return end
 seen=tag;inspecting=true
 local out=assert(io.open(folder..'/'..tag..'.ram','wb'));out:write(ram:read_block(0,ram.count));out:close()
 local row=context('snapshot');row.tag=tag;row.ranges=ranges;row.cpu_writes=writes;row.call_count=call_count;row.spc_controls=commands;emit(row)
 local done=assert(io.open(folder..'/'..tag..'.json','w'));done:write(json.stringify(row));done:close()
 inspecting=false
end)
emit({kind='observer-ready',ram_bytes=ram.count,qualification='Read-only save-item snapshots and passthrough CPU write taps. CPU write counts exclude direct DMA; snapshot differences include DMA. No access absence proves ownership.'})

"""Retain byte-checked UI ownership and ordinary-input stereo evidence."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re,struct,importlib.metadata
import numpy as np
import pypcode

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
WORK=HERE/'stereo-selection-02'
image=(ROOT/'S760224.IMG').read_bytes()
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def u16(b,a):return struct.unpack_from('<H',b,a)[0]
assert hashlib.sha256(image).hexdigest()=='3827ed4c46fd48abbec3095266164853033141d7bd15afe8dda0050d00e073cd'
assert image==(ROOT/'roms/System/S760224.IMG').read_bytes()
run=json.loads((WORK/'result.json').read_text())
assert run['source_unchanged']
assert all(sha(ROOT/p)==h for p,h in run['identities'].items())

static=[]
for name in ['frontier_p4b_62d4.asm','frontier_p4b_64d0.asm','frontier_p4b_65b6.asm','frontier_p4b_6698.asm','frontier_p10a_8d2c.asm','selection_refresh_services.asm']:
    p=ROOT/'firmware_source/os_disk/src'/name;rows=[]
    for line in p.read_text().splitlines():
        m=re.search(r'\[([0-9A-Fa-f]{6}): ([0-9A-Fa-f ]+)\]',line)
        if not m:continue
        offset=int(m[1],16);raw=bytes.fromhex(m[2])
        assert image[offset:offset+len(raw)]==raw
        rows.append(dict(file_offset=offset,bytes=raw.hex(),instruction=line.split(';')[0].strip()))
    static.append(dict(source=str(p.relative_to(ROOT)),sha256=sha(p),anchors=rows))
ctx=pypcode.Context('MCS96:LE:16:default');decoded=[]
for page,first,end in [(0x5a,0x4000,0x42e8),(0x3b,0x5f42,0x6065)]:
    offset=0x4800+(page<<10)+(first&0x3fff)
    ins=ctx.disassemble(image[offset:offset+end-first],base_address=first).instructions
    assert ins[-1].addr.offset+ins[-1].length==end
    decoded.append(dict(page=page,first=first,end_exclusive=end,instructions=[dict(pc=i.addr.offset,bytes=image[offset+i.addr.offset-first:offset+i.addr.offset-first+i.length].hex(),text=i.mnem+' '+i.body) for i in ins]))
# Explicit calculation from the qualified save/restore loops. The pixel loop
# assumes nonzero valid popup dimensions; malformed descriptor handling is not proved.
assert 4+1000*2+620*8*2*2==0x5554
crt=[dict(depth=d,physical_start=0xf0000+d*0x5554,max_end_exclusive=0xf0000+(d+1)*0x5554) for d in range(3)]
lcd=[dict(depth=d,physical_start=0xf0000+d*0x4000,end_exclusive=0xf0000+d*0x4000+0x2200) for d in range(3)]

snapshots=[]
for p in sorted((WORK/'runtime/bs1-observer').glob('frame-*.json')):
    raw=json.loads(p.read_text());ram=p.with_suffix('.ram').read_bytes();lo=raw['selectors']['0108']<<10
    partial=ram[0xd2780:0xd2800]
    records=[]
    for slot,phys in [(0,0xd2800),(1,0xd2830),(512,0xd8800),(513,0xd8830)]:
        rec=ram[phys:phys+48]
        records.append(dict(slot=slot,physical=phys,hex=rec.hex(),addresses=list(struct.unpack_from('<5I',rec,16)),start_block=u16(rec,40),block_count=u16(rec,42)))
    snapshots.append(dict(tag=p.stem,raw_context=raw,ram_sha256=sha(p.with_suffix('.ram')),screen_depth=ram[lo+0x2144],geometry=list(ram[lo+0x2148:lo+0x214c]),stereo_choice=ram[lo+0x2469],partner_found=ram[lo+0x246a],preview_mode=ram[lo+0x2a30],allocation_cursor=u16(ram,lo+0x3616),sample_records=records,partial255_hex=partial.hex(),partial_refs=[u16(partial,16),u16(partial,32)],partial_pans=[partial[20],partial[36]],first_popup_header_hex=ram[0xf0000:0xf0004].hex(),candidate_8002_sha256=hashlib.sha256(ram[0x3d3e:0x5c80]).hexdigest()))
assert len(snapshots)==12
assert snapshots[0]['partial_refs']==[65535,65535]
for i in [1,3,4,5,11]:assert snapshots[i]['partial_refs']==[512,513] and snapshots[i]['stereo_choice']==1
for i in [1,3,4]:assert snapshots[i]['partial_pans']==[224,32]
for i in [5,11]:assert snapshots[i]['partial_pans']==[32,224]
for i in [2,10]:assert snapshots[i]['partial_refs']==[512,65535] and snapshots[i]['stereo_choice']==0
assert snapshots[6]['screen_depth']==1 and snapshots[6]['first_popup_header_hex']=='1405110a'
for s in snapshots:
    assert s['sample_records'][:2]==snapshots[0]['sample_records'][:2]
    assert s['allocation_cursor']==26
for i in [1,3,4]:
    assert [r['start_block'] for r in snapshots[i]['sample_records'][2:]]==[0,13]
for i in [5,11]:
    assert [r['start_block'] for r in snapshots[i]['sample_records'][2:]]==[13,0]

# Compare the full allocations with the already-qualified saved fixture.
disk=(ROOT/'docs/ic20-hle-findings/chatGPT-work/bluescsi-feasibility-2026-10-18/stereo-04/captured-stereo.img').read_bytes()
wave=(WORK/'wave.bin').read_bytes();source=[];pcm=[]
for c,(period,step) in enumerate([(257,64),(509,32)]):
    raw=wave[16+c*119808:16+(c+1)*119808]
    assert raw==disk[0x2ac00+c*119808:0x2ac00+(c+1)*119808]
    values=np.frombuffer(raw,dtype='<i2')[:56719].astype(float);source.append(values)
    phase=int(values[0])//step+period//2
    assert np.array_equal(values,((np.arange(56719)+phase)%period-period//2)*step)
    assert not any(raw[56719*2:])
    pcm.append(dict(channel=c,frames=56719,allocation_bytes=119808,sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),period=period,step=step,initial_phase=phase))

audios=[]
for name,pairing in [('stereo-left-selected',[0,0]),('paired-left',[0,1]),('paired-right',[0,1]),('mono-right',[1,1]),('stereo-restored',[0,1])]:
    a=np.fromfile(WORK/(name+'.pcm'),dtype='<f4').reshape(-1,2)
    tail=np.fromfile(WORK/(name+'-tail.pcm'),dtype='<f4').reshape(-1,2)
    assert np.isfinite(a).all() and not np.any(tail[-44100:])
    fits=[]
    for channel,source_channel in enumerate(pairing):
        v=a[5000:30000,channel].astype(float);p=pcm[source_channel]['period'];step=pcm[source_channel]['step'];best=None
        for phase in range(p):
            reference=((np.arange(len(v))+phase)%p-p//2)*step
            gain=float(np.dot(v,reference)/np.dot(reference,reference))
            error=float(np.sqrt(np.mean((v-gain*reference)**2)))
            if best is None or error<best['rms_error']:
                best=dict(output_channel=channel,source_channel=source_channel,phase=phase,gain=gain,rms_error=error,relative_rms_error=error/float(np.sqrt(np.mean(v*v))),correlation=float(np.corrcoef(v,reference)[0,1]))
        assert best['correlation']>0.999999 and best['relative_rms_error']<1e-6
        fits.append(best)
    if pairing[0]==pairing[1]:assert np.array_equal(a[:,0],a[:,1])
    else:assert not np.array_equal(a[:,0],a[:,1])
    # For paired audio the fitted phases must correspond to the same position
    # in the recorded channels, not merely two independent matching periods.
    common=[]
    if pairing==[0,1]:
        common=[n for n in range(56719-25000+1) if all((pcm[c]['initial_phase']+n)%pcm[c]['period']==fits[c]['phase'] for c in range(2))]
        assert len(common)==1
